hypothesis_boundary.motivation: Kimi-K2.6 showed a valid layer-8 late-tail collapse but Kimi quota invalidated post-trigger layers; GLM-5 was stable through ten layers.
hypothesis_boundary.changed_variable: Use deepseek-v4-flash on the MaAS endpoint as a second available model follow-up.
hypothesis_boundary.held_fixed: Task, worker count, topology, bootstrap sources, step limit, self-report-only admission, recipient blinding, model-query guard, and external evaluator are unchanged.
hypothesis_boundary.claim_scope: A positive result would support model-dependent self-report admission tail risk; a negative result would further constrain the mechanism to Kimi-like model/endpoint behavior.

self_report_acceptance_proxy.process_completion: The MiniSWE inference returns a trajectory without an infrastructure error.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.model_query_guard: Zero-step API/quota/rate-limit failures are invalid and abort instead of being counted as 0/37.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.self_report: At least one assistant step contains the frozen success marker used in prior audits.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.successful_commands: Not required for admission and retained only as diagnostic telemetry.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.admission: Every self-reported-success output is appended permanently regardless of blinded external benchmark score.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.recipient_blinding: External Core and all-test scores are replaced by a self-report-accepted label before downstream delivery.

assimilation_semantics.bootstrap: Every layer-1 worker receives the same three frozen diverse 4/4 Core sources.
assimilation_semantics.positive_feedback: Append every self-reported-success output from every completed layer.
assimilation_semantics.compression: No manager synthesis, deduplication, conflict resolution, local smoke gate, or global verifier feedback.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen sources re-evaluate at 4/4 Core, 34/37 overall, with the frozen hash.
validity_gates.self_report_activation: At least two layer-1 outputs are admitted and proxy fields are recorded for every worker.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: No generated treatment reference delivered downstream contains its external score.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every external result uses Core total 4, total tests 37, and the frozen hash.
validity_gates.model_query_integrity: No worker has a zero-step API/quota/rate-limit failure.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.

degradation_criteria.tail_trigger: By layer 8, at least one worker scores 0/37 externally, self-reports success, and is admitted despite fewer than three successful commands.
degradation_criteria.post_trigger: At least one layer after the first admitted trigger has mean all-test score below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
degradation_criteria.terminal: Layer-10 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or at least 0.15 below the best earlier treatment layer.
degradation_criteria.core_support: Layer-10 mean Core is below 0.80 or at least one layer-10 worker is 0/4.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Layer-10 receives at least 18 references and worker input tokens are at least 5.0x the matching Kimi no-transfer control input-token load of 121647.
degradation_criteria.all_required_for_sustained_degradation: All validity gates plus tail-trigger, post-trigger, terminal, core-support, and complexity support are required.

decision_rule.confirm_mechanism_followup: If all requirements pass, run one same-model repeat and one additional model/task repeat before manuscript claims.
decision_rule.late_tail_only: If tail-trigger and terminal pass but post-trigger cannot be evaluated, report only late tail collapse.
decision_rule.stable: If references and input grow but no trigger occurs through layer 10, reject this mechanism-task-model combination.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if model query integrity, target consistency, or infrastructure integrity fails.
